ns2:section.sectionText: Registration is restricted until students have been accepted into the program by the Study Abroad Office. See the following link for more information. http://app.studyabroad.illinois.edu. This course meets the second eight weeks of Spring semester 3-11-13 to 5-1-13. Off campus dates are tentatively after spring semester ends. Cultural, Social, and Political Realities in Jordan This seminar provides key step towards developing a strong foundation for understanding the issue of immigration and integration in the Middle East. Here, I focus on Jordan as a case study. This course investigates how influxes of immigrants to Jordan during the last few decades have been impacting the local communities.
